criteria.criterion: Owner-approved milestones, main integration and dedicated review branch
22 authoritative Rust engines, 191 catalog operations, 25 workspaces and bounded auxiliary execution
Notebook editing, dependencies, cycles, stale results, selective recalculation, portable inert documents and financial plan
Formula creation, unit and domain constraints, pinned versions, tests and offline community library
Four declarative flows reproduce without AI, validate cumulative budgets, preserve exact data and recover after cancellation
Three modes, disabled factory state, validated proposals, questions, unavailable tools, real engine proofs, local replay and scoped native HTTPS/loopback adapters
Synthetic credentials, request-specific consent, offline rejection, bounded responses, zero automatic fallback and refusal of unauthorized operations
Local OCR and reviewed math; device voice availability recorded under the conditional media criterion
Historical proof compatibility and separation of model, input, engine proof, approximation and explanation
Five adaptive profiles, worker recovery, bounded memory, paired 0.5.1/0.6.0 physical benchmark and ongoing memory debt
Read-only Windows protection investigation with time bounds and attribution limits
25 modules across seven locales, 1050 directional comparisons and 42 separate Intelligence checks
Historical regression, independent math and finance checks, scientific coverage and Optimization follow-up
Windows/browser functionality, bilingual review evidence, artifact hashes and hosted checks

delivery_gate.condition: The four jobs must succeed on the exact evidence commit. The GitHub Actions run for that SHA is the immutable external delivery receipt.
